description: This Java source file defines the 'StagedCommand' class, which represents a non-serializable, local-only command used in multi-stage processing within the connection persistence subsystem. It encapsulates a sequence of actions, associated events, responses, and related metadata, facilitating asynchronous and synchronous handling of connectivity commands in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: StagedCommand
classes.description: A class representing a multi-stage, local-only connectivity command with an associated sequence of actions, facilitating asynchronous processing and event handling in the connection persistence layer.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of StagedCommand with specified command, event, response, and actions.

methods.name: dummyEvent
methods.description: Returns a dummy or placeholder ConnectivityEvent used internally.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the wrapped ConnectivityCommand.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Returns the ConnectivityEvent associated with this staged command.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the response headers to be sent.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef sender of the command.

methods.name: withSenderUnlessDefined
methods.description: Returns a new StagedCommand with the specified sender unless a sender is already defined.

methods.name: withResponse
methods.description: Returns a copy of this command with a new response.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionId associated with the command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the DittoHeaders attached to the command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new StagedCommand with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the command to a JsonObject based on schema version and predicate.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the manifest string of the command.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string of the command.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code for the object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the object.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Indicates if there are more actions in the sequence.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns a new StagedCommand advancing the action sequence.

methods.name: nextAction
methods.description: Returns the next action to perform.
